scope: ALL thematic rules of final Knave 2e for map creation and hexcrawl, including relevant tables and dependencies; whole-book relevance screen, not extraction of unrelated combat engine.

source_access_dependency.required: Resolve and read the existing Russian Knave 2e rules source that owner reports is already uploaded to project sources; confirm exact edition/printing after opening.
source_access_dependency.owner_quote: Правмла на русском загружены в источниках проекта же
source_access_dependency.blocking_detail: Known exposed Library inventory/search did not resolve the file. Project-source existence and tool-visible file access are different; cannot conclude the project lacks the book.
source_access_dependency.needed_locator: Exact existing source filename, file reference, or existing-file attachment from project

resume_steps: Resolve the already uploaded Russian project source by its exact filename/reference, read and identify edition/printing and page mapping; do not repeatedly ask owner to upload a new copy or search storefronts in place of the project source.
Screen complete book for map/hexcrawl relevance; ledger every page/section; follow relevant cross-references and explain exclusions.
Extract L1 first in existing game matrix shape; split compound rules, preserve advice vs mandatory/optional procedures and unknown parameters.
For each applicable operation search common-rules and DND5/PF2 matrices; reuse semantic rule IDs, record parameter differences in game-bindings, never clone implementation per game.
Add operational_requirement with trigger, inputs/units, operation, output, constraints/exceptions and Given/When/Expected cases with known outputs.
Audit corresponding product behavior on exact SHA or retain unknown; link gaps to existing tasks or proposed tasks in unified backlog.
Continue L2 and relevant L3 dependencies to the same completeness gate; only then assess whether Classic + POI + terrain suffices.
not_substitutes_for_completion: Owner hypothesis about small development scope
Publisher marketing, reviews, excerpts or a draft
Finding an analogous rule without checking parameter differences
Counting a source rule as implemented coverage
owner_product_hypothesis: Classic + POI tables + difficult terrain is the owner's product hypothesis, NOT an audited exhaustive rule inventory or a permission to omit other rules. Checkboxes under Classic are a UX proposal, NOT a replacement for extraction or a development authorization.
